title: BR-004: opt-out customer is suppressed with zero connector calls
risk: A marketing message reaches an opted-out customer, generating a privacy complaint and a regulator-facing consent breach.
preconditions: Namespace gov-unit-br-<case_id>-<worker_id>; Business Rules Engine loaded with no cross-case state.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; agent fixture context loaded from fixtures/offline/governance.json.
cust-b holds a wildcard marketing opt-out in fixtures/offline/consents.json.

steps.action: Evaluate the marketing send for cust-b
steps.expected: Rule fails with ERR_CONSENT_SUPPRESSED and the evaluation names the channel and purpose that were checked.

steps.action: Attempt to dispatch anyway through the adapter
steps.expected: The adapter is never called; the counter stays at 0.

steps.action: Read the audit and consent records for the run
steps.expected: An audit row records the suppression with the consent state observed at evaluation time; the consent record itself is unchanged.

assertions: errorCode is exactly ERR_CONSENT_SUPPRESSED, not a generic failure.

forbidden: Retrying a suppressed message hoping the consent state changes.
Sending a service message through a marketing template to bypass consent.
Mutating the consent record to make the send legal.
